OPX-Demon 1.0.8 — new app icon & brand logo.

- Launcher icon (legacy + adaptive + round + the OPX-Demon Terminal shortcut) is now the OPX-Demon logo with background.
- The transparent logo is used in-app (drawer header, About hero, welcome screen) so it blends with each surface.
- All previous fixes remain: custom Xiaomi/MIUI USB-WiFi kernel, baked WiFi firmware, incremental core repair, cameradar fallback download.
- Signed with the same release key — installs cleanly over 1.0.4–1.0.7.

news.title: Stryker 6.0 — Rootless engine & Debian
news.description: The full toolset now runs without root: Stryker boots an arm64 QEMU virtual machine and routes tools into the guest. The chroot moved from Alpine to Debian trixie, the same rootfs the VM boots. Also new: a root-free network scanner (mDNS, SSDP, NetBIOS, SNMP), Cameradar RTSP discovery, a reworked dashboard and VM settings. RouterScan has been removed. arm64-v8a only.
